title: Fayya iyya yallih taama-aqayna
intro: Atu dumaahi waktik xabba haanam, Yallih taama abeynak, qaadik yan marak dagah yan guddaaqa fan fayya heeh yan numuk tutucto taabbe. ta numtin amoh axawah tan sabri kee qigdu numma kinnim tamixxigeeh, farmok wadirih uduure ummattah ruube. Tah fayyale rooci miyyaay?
clues: Anu Yalli farmoytah dooriteeh, Qur'aanak saytunnos yok galab kak xageh an.
Anu inni sabrii kee nummat yalli faatitah yan caalatal amixxigeh suge.
Anu inni ummatta inki rabbi akah taamitannah seece, takkay immay mango mari yoo cineh.
yi guddaaqa Yalli fayya inteeh, fayyale caddo yoh yomcowwe.
Anu mango uddur gersi farmoytit axcih Ismaaqil kee Zul-Kifl lih galab kak xageh an.
Yalli yoo wagittaamal iyyam: kaadu nanu kaa fayya hayne. (19:57)

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Fayya le caddo fan fayya heen
outcome.answer: Fayya le caddo fan fayya heen
